en.headline: Tourism Board stages first Hong Kong Halloween Month
en.dek: Street parties are planned on three Saturdays from 17 October in Central, Kai Tak, Lan Kwai Fong, Mong Kok and Tsim Sha Tsui East.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board has announced its first Hong Kong Halloween Month, expanding what had been a one-night or single-venue promotion into a citywide series through the second half of October.

Street celebrations are scheduled for three consecutive Saturdays from 17 October in Central, Kai Tak, Lan Kwai Fong, Mong Kok and Tsim Sha Tsui East, ending on Halloween night, 31 October. The board said it is working with Hongkong Land, Kai Tak Sports Park, the Lan Kwai Fong Association, Langham Place and Sino Group. Programmes listed by the organisers include costume gatherings, music events, cosplay sessions and light installations, with different themes at each site.

Citybus and Hong Kong Tramways will run Halloween night experiences on those three Saturdays. Citybus plans an open-top sightseeing route linking several event areas; passengers in costume may ride free, the board said. Tramways will put two Halloween-themed party trams on the Causeway Bay to Sheung Wan corridor, also free for passengers in costume on those evenings.

Executive director Anthony Lau said the board wants visitors thinking of Halloween to consider Hong Kong first. Separate Halloween programmes at Hong Kong Disneyland and Ocean Park continue into early November.

zh.headline: 旅發局首辦香港萬聖月 三個周六街頭派對
zh.dek: 十月十七日起一連三個星期六，中環、啟德、蘭桂坊、旺角及尖東將舉辦萬聖節街頭活動，萬聖夜作結。
body: 香港旅遊發展局公布首辦「香港萬聖月」，將以往集中於單日或個別場地的萬聖節推廣，擴展為十月下旬橫跨全城的一連串活動。
街頭派對訂於十月十七日起一連三個星期六舉行，地點包括中環、啟德、蘭桂坊、旺角及尖沙咀東部，至十月三十一日萬聖夜。旅發局表示與置地公司、啟德體育園、蘭桂坊協會、朗豪坊及信和集團合作，各區節目包括變裝聚會、音樂活動、角色扮演及燈光裝置，主題各有不同。
旅發局聯同城巴及香港電車，於上述三個星期六晚上推出萬聖節夜間體驗。城巴將開辦開篷觀光路線穿梭多個活動點，穿上萬聖節裝扮的乘客可免費乘搭；電車則安排兩輛萬聖節主題派對電車行走銅鑼灣至上環一段，同日晚上同樣免費予盛裝乘客登車。
旅發局總幹事劉鎮漢表示，希望旅客想到慶祝萬聖節時會首先想起香港。香港迪士尼樂園及海洋公園的萬聖節節目則另行舉行，至十一月初。
